functionDescriptions: Probable lectin that binds selectively to improperly folded lumenal proteins. May function in endoplasmic reticulum quality control and endoplasmic reticulum-associated degradation (ERAD) of both non- glycosylated proteins and glycoproteins. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:16531414, ECO:0000269|PubMed:18264092, ECO:0000269|PubMed:18502753}.
